_comment: DEFAULT SEED / documentation only. Live per-platform flags are managed in the internal dashboard (Cloudflare KV, edited at https://dashboard.cumulusvpn.com/admin) and served at https://dashboard.cumulusvpn.com/api/flags, which the app fetches at launch. Both platforms are OFF: the in-app FLUX crypto purchase UI is a store-policy violation (Apple 3.1.1 / Google Play Payments), so store builds MUST keep this OFF — when OFF the app shows NO purchase UI at all (no upgrade screen, no upsell line, no price, no 'manage on the web' copy; the tier is displayed as a plain status only). Enable only for direct-APK / off-store Android builds, and never for a build under or past store review (a post-review behavior change is itself a violation). The iOS client additionally hard-disables this at build level (clients/mobile/src/lib/flags.ts PURCHASE_UI_PLATFORMS), so 'ios': true would have no effect there. If the app can't fetch flags it fails closed to OFF anyway. Seed KV from this file (values below, without _comment).
